inputs_sent.prompt: Keep everything in image 1 exactly as it is: the same sunlit room, the same camera position and framing, the same warm light, and the same man sitting up in bed holding his phone, who has not moved. Add one new element: a faint double of the man, made of soft mint light (#b7f4cf), stands on the floor beside the desk in the warm daylight. He is an exact copy of the man shown in image 2 and image 3, who is also the man in the bed: the same face, the same short dark hair and trimmed beard, the same warm medium-brown skin, the same dark charcoal T-shirt and the same loose dark grey pyjama trousers. His face and skin keep their own natural brown colour and his clothes keep their own dark colours; only the light is pale mint-green (#b7f4cf). He glows softly from within and is slightly see-through, with soft edges and no drawn outline. He looks at the man in bed with a warm, gentle smile, lips closed. He is in the middle of going back into the phone: from the waist down he has already turned into a ribbon of soft mint light with fine glowing particles, which sweeps across the room and flows into the screen of the phone in the hands of the man in bed; the phone's screen glows mint where the ribbon enters it. The man in bed looks at his phone, calm and rested, with a small smile. It must read as friendly, advanced technology, never as a ghost or a spirit: no mist, no smoke, no dark shadows, nothing spooky. There are exactly two people: the solid man in bed and the faint man of light. Photorealistic, like a frame from a premium advertising film. Nothing written anywhere.
